content_blocks.label: clause_1._Premises
content_blocks.text: The Landlord hereby leases to the Tenant the Premises located at 123 Main Street, Springfield, State of Novaria.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Term
content_blocks.text: The Term of this Agreement shall commence on April 1, 2024 and end on March 31, 2029, unless terminated earlier as provided herein.

content_blocks.label: clause_3.1_Rental_Payment
content_blocks.text: The Tenant shall pay the Monthly Rent of $5,000.00, payable on the first day of each month, commencing May 1, 2024.
